headline: Livestock Safety and Responsible Camping
reservation: Wild camping is not permitted; visitors must book official campsites in advance. Specific attractions and busy hotels require forward planning to ensure availability. Systems for local facilities are managed by individual providers and Forestry England, so check official New Forest NPA updates for seasonal changes.

days.title: Ancient Woods and Wildlife

stops.name: Blackwater Arboretum
stops.detail: Walk the accessible trail through a diverse collection of trees in the heart of the forest.

stops.name: Tall Trees Trail
stops.detail: Experience the scale of ancient woodland with veteran trees along these established paths.

days.driving: Allow for slow travel on forest roads; conditions vary with livestock presence.
days.note: Ponies and cattle have right of way; pass them wide and slow at all times.

days.title: Coastal Views and History

stops.name: Buckler's Hard
stops.detail: Discover the maritime heritage of ship-building along the Beaulieu River.

stops.name: Ashlett Creek
stops.detail: Explore the unspoilt coastline and saltmarshes on this three-mile easy walking route.

days.driving: Rough daily travel allowance between the southern coast and central villages.
days.note: Keep dogs under close control near the coast to avoid disturbing over-wintering birds.

days.title: Heathlands and Local Heritage

stops.name: Burley Village
stops.detail: Walk the four-mile circular trail through open heathland and traditional forest architecture.

stops.name: Copythorne Common
stops.detail: Visit this area managed for nature to see the commoning system in action.

days.driving: Allow for travel on B-roads; expect animals on or near the road at any time.
days.note: Sticking to tracks from February to August protects rare ground-nesting birds.

intel.title: Official Car Parks
intel.text: Parking on verges is prohibited; use designated car parks to protect the fragile soil and habitats. Some car parks may face temporary closures for winter maintenance or forestry work.

intel.title: Variable Connectivity
intel.text: Signal is generally available in major villages like Brockenhurst but can be patchy in deep woodland areas. Download the New Forest National Park Walks app for offline trail data.

intel.title: Regional Refueling
intel.text: Fuel stations are located in larger gateway towns and villages such as Lyndhurst. Ensure your tank is sufficient for slow-speed driving through internal forest tracks.

intel.title: Seasonal Awareness
intel.text: Autumn brings the 'pannage' season when pigs are released to eat acorns, and deer rutting occurs. Winter visitors should watch for livestock licking salt from gritted roads.

intel.title: Track Restrictions
intel.text: Cycling is only permitted on a network of specific waymarked routes to avoid disturbing wildlife. Walking access is broad, but visitors must stay on tracks during bird breeding seasons.

plan.arrival: First two hours: Train arrival at Brockenhurst or rental pickup in Southampton, followed by supply shopping for local New Forest Marque produce.
plan.vehicle: Cars are ideal; larger RVs must check height and weight restrictions on minor forest roads.
plan.goldenHour: Open heathland areas offer clear views for sunrise and sunset; exact timing is season-dependent.
